label: engine-resource-after-owned-temp-cleanup
command:
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
base = root / "docs/experiments/results/engine-continuation-checks-001"
continuation = json.loads((root / "work/continuations/engine-2026-09-19.json").read_text())
start = datetime.fromisoformat(continuation["started_at"]).timestamp()
def size(path):
    files = [p for p in path.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()]
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files), "files": len(files)}
def created(path):
    return path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_birthtime >= start
artifacts = [size(p) for p in sorted((root / "artifacts").iterdir()) if created(p)]
temporary = Path(tempfile.gettempdir())
tests = [size(p) for p in sorted((temporary / "pytest-of-danielwahnich").iterdir()) if created(p)]
proposals = [size(p) for p in sorted(temporary.glob("nisayon-history-fixture-proposal-*")) if created(p)]
runs = [size(p) for p in sorted((root / ".nisayon/runs").iterdir()) if created(p)]
added = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=A", "-z", "21ed4f6a8d8c1f1acbef1036d8f7d31f83e29755", "HEAD"], cwd=root).decode().split("\0")
untracked = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"], cwd=root).decode().split("\0")
working = sum((root / name).stat().st_size for name in set(added + untracked) if name and (root / name).is_file())
retained_bytes = sum(item["bytes"] for item in artifacts + tests + proposals + runs) + working
free = shutil.disk_usage(root).free
result = {
    "schema": "nisayon.engine-resource-snapshot.v1",
    "recorded_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "continuation_start": continuation["started_at"],
    "new_artifact_directories": artifacts,
    "remaining_test_temporary_directories": tests,
    "isolated_proposal_temporary_directories": proposals,
    "command_record_directories": runs,
    "added_git_working_files_bytes": working,
    "known_retained_non_environment_bytes": retained_bytes,
    "cap_bytes": 1024**3,
    "free_disk_bytes": free,
    "minimum_free_disk_bytes": 5*1024**3,
    "source_download_bytes": continuation["source_download_bytes"],
    "source_download_cap_bytes": 64*1024**2,
    "scope": "Logical retained payload in artifact directories, remaining pytest/proposal directories, command records created during this continuation and added/untracked Git working files. Includes copies; excludes environments and shared Git object storage. Temporary-directory inclusion is conservative and does not establish other-session ownership. This is a retained-size observation, not a historical peak or allocation meter.",
    "transient_controls": "D01/D05 raw-store checks used sequential self-cleaning temporary copies of 161 MiB/264 MiB. The latest full-suite run's temporary store is included if retained. No other-session cleanup was performed.",
    "running_measurement_exclusion": "This command's final logs/metadata and subsequent small closeout records do not yet have their final byte count.",
}
path = base / "resource-snapshot.json"
prior = base / "resource-snapshot-20260919T082026.json"
if not prior.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(path, prior)
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
ids = {Path(r["path"]).name for r in runs}
print(json.dumps({"retained_non_environment_bytes": retained_bytes, "free_disk_bytes": free, "source_download_bytes":continuation["source_download_bytes"], "command_directories":len(runs), "not_yet_in_continuation_ledger":sorted(ids-set(continuation["command_records"]))}, indent=2))

assert retained_bytes < result["cap_bytes"] and free > result["minimum_free_disk_bytes"]
